tasks.short: Join design reviews and give input on requirements.

steps.what: Read the product designs, requirements and schedules.
Participate in the product design review.
Provide input on functional requirements and problems.
File the input from that design review.

tasks.design: The tester reads the designs and the schedules, then participates in the review. The input on requirements and problems is theirs. Filing it on {PROJECT} is a copy of what they wrote. The review is not replaced by a comment generator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Input was spoken in the review and lost when the notes were someone else's.
tasks.enabler_now: A filed note can hold the words the tester already wrote. It cannot attend the review.
tasks.still_hard: A schedule that is too tight for the risk, and a design that will be hard to test, stay a judgement in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The tester sees the case the design forgot, because they have tested the last one.
tasks.altitude: The input has a place after the review. Attending and deciding what to say stay.

reach.task: Read the tester's input on the design
reach.learn: Which requirement the input is about

evidence.claim: Filing a note the tester wrote is a record. Participating in the review is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester participates and provides input. The designer owns the design. Approving the design is not this task.
Structured input: design id, requirement id, input text the tester wrote. Producer is the tester. An empty input is not filed.
The meeting is the large share and stays. No draft speaks for the tester.
unknowns: Are design reviews already on the calendar?
research_questions: How often is a test concern raised and then lost?

already_counted.description: The design review itself is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire input on designs that were dropped.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If designs are not shared before the meeting, the reading stays and only the filing helps. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan test schedules and strategies against delivery dates.

steps.what: Pull project scope and delivery dates.
Draft test schedules that fit those dates.

loop.input: the scope items and the delivery dates
loop.output: schedules whose test days sit before those dates
loop.check: every test day must be on or before the delivery date; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a scope item with no date is left unscheduled
loop.why_not_simpler: which strategy fits the risk is not a calendar

steps.what: Choose schedules and strategies for that scope.
Publish the schedules on the project.

tasks.design: Scope and delivery dates come from {PROJECT}. A draft schedule is kept only when every test day is on or before the delivery date. The tester chooses the schedule and the strategy. Publishing follows that choice.
tasks.previous_blocker: The schedule was a private list that missed the delivery date until late.
tasks.enabler_now: A date comparison is arithmetic. The strategy for a risky area is not.
tasks.still_hard: What to test first when the date is close stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which area cannot be left to the last day.
tasks.altitude: Building a date-safe draft takes less time. Choosing the strategy stays.

reach.task: See when their change will be tested
reach.learn: Which scope items are on the schedule

evidence.claim: A schedule that must finish before a delivery date can be checked. The test strategy cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester plans the schedule. Delivery dates are owned by the project. Running the tests is later.
Structured input: scope id, delivery date, test days. Producer is the project record. A day after the delivery date is discarded.
The choice is remaining time. Publishing does not pick the strategy.
unknowns: Are delivery dates in the project record?
research_questions: How often does testing start after the date has already slipped?

already_counted.description: Choosing the strategy is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire schedules for scope that was cut.

approvals.approved_version: schedule and strategy the tester chose for that scope

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If delivery dates are not recorded, the draft cannot be checked and the tester plans by hand. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor program performance for sound operations.

steps.what: Show program performance against the last release.
Monitor the running program for problems.
Decide whether operations are efficient enough.
Log the performance watch and the decision.

tasks.design: A view on {BI} shows program performance against the last release. The tester still monitors the running program. The decision that operations are or are not efficient enough stays theirs. The log records that watch. An alert does not declare a problem.
tasks.previous_blocker: Performance was glanced at when a user complained, with no comparison to the last release.
tasks.enabler_now: A measure against a previous release is a query. Whether operations are healthy is not.
tasks.still_hard: A slow path that the numbers understate, because it hits only one job, stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which slowness the user will actually feel.
tasks.altitude: The comparison is ready without a private sheet. Monitoring and the decision stay.

reach.task: See the watch when a measure moved
reach.learn: What the tester decided about operations

evidence.claim: A comparison with the last release is a query. Declaring the program problem-free is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester monitors. Capacity planning and buying hardware are different tasks. A single defect is filed elsewhere.
Structured input: program, measure, release, value. Producer is the running system. A measure with no release is shown as unmatched.
Watching the program is the large share and stays.
unknowns: Who acts when operations are not efficient enough?
research_questions: How often is a performance problem found only by a user?

already_counted.description: Monitoring the program is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire watches for programs that were retired.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If measures are not collected, the view is empty and the tester still watches. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Run compatibility tests across programs, hardware and environments.

steps.what: Choose programs, hardware, systems and environments.
Draft the compatibility matrix for that set.

loop.input: the programs, hardware and environments the tester chose
loop.output: a matrix whose rows are only that set
loop.check: every row must be one the tester chose; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a missing environment is not invented
loop.why_not_simpler: which failure blocks release is not a matrix

steps.what: Conduct the compatibility tests on that matrix.
Decide which failures block the software release.
File the compatibility results and the decision.

tasks.design: The tester chooses programs, hardware, operating systems and environments. The matrix contains only that set. The tester conducts the tests and decides which failures block release. {PROJECT} files the decision. The run is not a grid filled by a model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Compatibility was tried on whatever machine was free, and the set was not written down.
tasks.enabler_now: A matrix of a chosen set is a table. A pass on that row is still a run.
tasks.still_hard: A failure on an old environment that almost nobody uses stays a release judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which environment the customer actually has.
tasks.altitude: The matrix is no longer rebuilt by hand. Choosing the set, running the tests and deciding the block stay.

reach.learn: Which combinations were in the set

evidence.claim: A matrix limited to a chosen set can be checked. A compatibility run cannot be skipped because the cell exists.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester conducts the tests and decides. Provisioning every environment is a different task when it is heavy install work.
Structured input: program, hardware, operating system, environment, result. Producer is the tester for the set and the run. A row the tester did not choose is discarded.
The run is the large share and stays.
unknowns: Is there a support matrix of environments?
Who decides an old environment can fail?
research_questions: How often is a customer environment missing from the set?

already_counted.description: Conducting the tests is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire environments the firm no longer supports.

approvals.approved_version: block decision the tester made for that matrix

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the environments are not named, the matrix is empty and the tester still runs what they can reach. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Design reviews, performance watches and compatibility runs stay in person. The schedule draft must fit the delivery date, and the tester still chooses the strategy.
reach: Developers see the tester's input on the design.
The project shows the test days.
skills_to_grow: Say when a date leaves no room for the risky area.
Decide which compatibility failure blocks release.
role.ambitious_version: A schedule that misses the delivery date is not published, and a performance watch has a log.
